in_sanskrit.name: बल-गोपाल
in_sanskrit.meaning: Strong or powerful Gopal (god of abundance)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds or protects the cowherd. Bal (बल) means strong, powerful, or heroic and Gopal (गोपाल) is a derivative of Govinda (गोविन्द) which means 'god of abundance'.

in_tamil.name: பல-கோபால
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds or protects the cowherd. Bal (பல) means strong, powerful, or heroic and Kopal (கொப்பள்) is a derivative of Kuppan (குப்பன்) or Kuppai (குப்பை) which means 'god of abundance'.

in_marathi.name: Balagopal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Power of Balance, Lord Vishnu's Divine Child
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balagopal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balagopal is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Bal' meaning 'power' and 'Gopal' meaning 'Lord Vishnu'. Balagopal is a divine name representing the power of balance and the divine child of Lord Vishnu. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is known to restore balance and harmony in the universe.
